title: Permit only valid superseded archive evidence in PR validation
rawUserRequest: 完成全部工单为止不要停。要确认的，我授权给你，并写入contract。

declaredIntent.summary: Make PR aggregate validation honor the same narrow receipt-bound supersession rule used by archive creation.

outOfScope: Do not relax validation for ordinary archived or active Work Items.
Do not modify the preserved bytes of superseded predecessor Outcome artifacts.
Do not merge or delete PR #792 until its required checks pass.

riskAssessment.reason: A broadened exception could let incomplete failed Work Items evade required verification; the change must be restricted to receipt-bound valid supersession.

reasons: A bounded governance-validation correction needs focused regression and full quality verification.

executionDecision.reason: The user authorized corrective completion and lifecycle cleanup; the code path and required negative cases are fully specified.

preReviewWarnings: Review the exception predicate and negative cases to ensure it cannot mask ordinary required-verification failures.

checkpointPolicy.reason: Record at least one checkpoint before finishing to reduce mid-task drift.

acceptance: PR validation accepts archived Summary required-verification errors only when ai_lifecycle_truth proves the exact receipt-bound superseded transition; all other Summary errors remain failures.
Regression tests prove the positive valid-supersession case and reject invalid receipt binding, unbound failed verification, and unrelated Summary errors.
The correction passes focused tests and all declared quality/governance gates without modifying the archived predecessor Outcome bytes.
guidelines: Reuse ai_lifecycle_truth as the sole authority for supersession semantics; do not duplicate or broaden the predicate.
Fail closed for every non-superseded, malformed, stale, or unrelated Summary validation error.
Keep the evidence exception local to archived PR validation and preserve ordinary required-verification enforcement.

intent.problem: A valid archive transaction for a blocked predecessor preserves its red Outcome and receipt-bound evidence, but the downstream PR aggregate applies stricter generic Summary validation and rejects the same transaction. This leaves the historical archive branch unmergeable after all project-test shards complete.
constraints: The exception must use the existing receipt-bound is_valid_superseded_transition authority.
The archived predecessor's red Outcome JSON and Markdown must remain byte-preserved.
Ordinary required verification, malformed evidence, and unrelated errors must continue to fail closed.
intent.rationale: Applying the same narrow lifecycle predicate at both archive creation and PR aggregation makes the lifecycle internally consistent without treating an unverified Work Item as successful.
